item.text: I can do that, but I need one bit of orientation first: “same files” as which existing change or planned work? I’m in a read-only sandbox right now, so I can inspect the repo and propose an exact patch, but I won’t be able to write the files unless the environment is reopened with write access.

Yes, I can help, but I need two details before I can do anything useful:

1. What is the “new unplanned feature” you want added?
2. Which “same files” should I touch, or what existing/ongoing change are we sharing files with?

One constraint on my side: this session is currently in a read-only filesystem sandbox, so I can inspect the repo and produce an exact patch/diff, but I cannot apply edits directly in the workspace from here.
